method: Authenticated Posts and Posts-and-replies crawls were exhausted and combined with yearly authored Latest searches. Every profile-counted slot receives a disposition; a bounded incoming-mention search and strict historical Council-member review remain separate stakeholder evidence.
publicSafety: The public census stores status URLs, source dates and handles, relationship types, posted-link metadata, hashtags, bounded classifications, digests, and dated interface counts. It excludes full post bodies, cookies, account credentials, private messages, follower identities, and session state.

population.platformBoundary: X documents an 800-record Posts display limit, a 3,200-record Posts-and-replies display limit, and older-post indexing restrictions. X directs account owners to the X Archive for history beginning with the first post. The 2,001 unmaterialized slots are not described as deleted, absent, or nonexistent.

publishingPattern.recordTypeMethod: recordType partitions the 3,123 unique source-status URLs: account-authored source statuses are original or reply, while external source statuses surfaced through native repost cards are repost. Quote-post source statuses remain original even when the quoted card is a reply. Two account-authored quote-post URLs also appeared as native self-repost cards; their source-status identity remains original and the nonexclusive appearance is retained separately.
publishingPattern.classificationMethod: Mission signals are deterministic matches against source-post body text, hashtags, and displayed link destinations after profile chrome and quoted-card content are excluded. Raw text is intentionally excluded; the public rule manifest, per-row input digest, and first matched public-safe phrase support positive-label audit and private-capture reproduction. Full false-negative replay requires the private raw capture. Signals can overlap and describe subject matter, not authorship, endorsement, causality, or impact.
publishingPattern.boundary: Record type partitions unique source-status URLs. For native reposts, the visible date and engagement belong to the external source status and do not date or measure @NYCArtC's repost action. Two account-authored statuses also appeared as native self-reposts; source identity and timeline appearance remain separate axes.

urlInventory.boundary: The inventory preserves every posted t.co link recovered from the public population. Sources circulated through native reposts remain the source author's work and are contextual evidence, not coverage of NYC Artist Coalition unless the source itself says so.

hashtagInventory.boundary: Hashtags are public publishing signals. Counts can overlap and are not measures of campaign reach, participation, or outcomes.

sourceAuthorNetwork.boundary: The unique-URL population contains 685 @NYCArtC-authored source statuses and 2,438 external source statuses surfaced through native repost cards. Two of the account-authored quote-post URLs also appeared as native self-repost cards, so source-status identity and timeline appearance are recorded as separate axes. Appearance in this network does not by itself establish that the source account engaged with the coalition, endorsed a campaign, collaborated with Jamie, or authorized the repost.

missionSignalClassification.matchPolicy: A record receives a signal when at least one normalized input matches the rule. Profile chrome, source display names, and quoted-card content are excluded from source-post-body. The fixture retains an input digest plus the first matched value and input field for each assigned signal while excluding the surrounding post text.
missionSignalClassification.boundary: Signal matches support corpus subject classification only. The public fixture audits positive matches and publishes input digests; full false-negative replay requires the private raw capture. Labels do not establish who authored a post, whether a source account engaged, campaign endorsement, policy causality, participation, reach, or impact.

visibleEngagementSnapshot.boundary: The 618-record count includes account-authored source statuses with at least one displayed reply, repost, or like. Displayed counts are volatile interface observations, not unique people, reach, conversion, endorsement, participation, or impact. Views and bookmarks are excluded from both that record count and the interaction-unit total; only account-authored source statuses are included, even when one also appeared as a native self-repost card.

strictThenServingCouncilMemberResult.boundary: This is the existing strict authenticated minimum from direct mentions and conversation-verified replies. It is not a complete historical total and does not establish endorsement, adoption, legislative authorship, or policy causality.
